record.body:
## Rationale

Skills already clear gates through adaptive-artifacts. Reusing the CLI from the dashboard keeps one mutation path, revision checks, and validation, and avoids a second in-process write stack beside the viewer.

## Counter-argument

An in-process library would be faster and avoid PATH/shell issues; it would also couple the dashboard to runtime internals and risk diverging from the CLI contract skills use.
